label: TP
reason: Both java/xss and java/tainted-format-string alerts identify user input from Referer header flowing to response.getWriter().format(). The mitigation (last character replacement with Z in doSomething) does not prevent XSS payloads positioned before the final character, nor does it stop format specifier injection. User-controlled data reaches both sinks unprotected.

evidence.note: User input from Referer header flows through URL decode to doSomething, then to response writer format call; insufficient mitigation leaves most of payload exposed
Same flow enables format string vulnerability as bar (from user input) serves as format specifier argument
